<script>
function toggleView(section, type) {
  var gridWrap = document.getElementById(section + '-grid-wrap');
  var listWrap = document.getElementById(section + '-list-wrap');
  var btnGrid  = document.getElementById(section.substring(0,4) === 'fund' ? 'fund-btn-grid' : 'adv-btn-grid');
  var btnList  = document.getElementById(section.substring(0,4) === 'fund' ? 'fund-btn-list' : 'adv-btn-list');
  if (type === 'grid') {
    gridWrap.style.display = '';
    listWrap.style.display = 'none';
    btnGrid.classList.add('active');
    btnList.classList.remove('active');
  } else {
    gridWrap.style.display = 'none';
    listWrap.style.display = '';
    btnGrid.classList.remove('active');
    btnList.classList.add('active');
  }
}
</script>

<style>
.view-toggle-bar {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.view-btn {
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border: 1.5px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.9em;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.view-btn:hover {
  border-color: #666;
  background: #f5f5f5;
}
.view-btn.active {
  background: #2c3e50;
  color: white;
  border-color: #2c3e50;
}
</style>
